workflow_test.name: ai: every run is logged for the person
workflow_test.description: A run adds one usage row: who, which action, on what, and that it went fine.

workflow_test.name: ai: each person has their own rate limit
workflow_test.description: After 5 runs in the window a person is refused; someone else still can run.

workflow_test.name: approvals: asking only records a request
workflow_test.description: An agent's request is stored as pending with the action's button and editable field. Nothing runs.

workflow_test.name: approvals: a request expires
workflow_test.description: Past its expiry, nobody can approve or decline it.

workflow_test.name: approvals: "apply_ai" is decided by an admin, never the requester
workflow_test.description: Routed by role: the requester gets not-found even when they hold the role, so does anyone without it; a role holder decides.

workflow_test.name: fixture: a viewer can run AI on their note but not apply
workflow_test.description: can.write refuses a viewer's apply with a plain reason; the note is unchanged.

workflow_test.name: fixture: a viewer can't use AI on tickets at all
workflow_test.description: can.read refuses the run itself.

value1.value: You can't use AI on tickets

workflow_test.name: fixture: an admin may act on someone else's note
workflow_test.description: can.others lets an admin past the owner rule; the write is theirs.

workflow_test.name: fixture: ticket context comes from the app's function
workflow_test.description: A function context is what the model (here the stub) reads.

workflow_test.name: fixture: a gated apply waits for approval, then writes as the approver
workflow_test.description: Nothing is written until an admin approves; then only the validated values are written, as the admin.

workflow_test.name: fixture: a gated apply with an invalid value is refused before anyone is asked
workflow_test.description: Approvers only ever see changes that would pass validation.
